content.text: No minimum commitment exists anywhere in the agreement; the preferred position is met.

input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms that Customer pays only for Services ordered under a mutually executed Order Form, with non-ordering carrying no breach or shortfall consequence. Section 7.1 additionally bars any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form, and Section 12.3 records that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. Searches for minimum, shortfall, take-or-pay, volume caps and usage limits found no take-or-pay, no volume restriction on Customer usage, and no penalty mechanic; the Section 22.2/22.3 audit "shortfall" is a true-up of actual underpayment, not a commitment. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
